get.description:
Returns a paginated, filtered list of audit-trail entries, newest first.
Accepts `search`, `event`, `causer_id`, `date_from`, `date_to`, `sort_dir`
and `per_page` (capped at 100 to bound resource consumption — OWASP API4).

Returns a single audit-trail entry with its full property and
attribute-change payloads.

post.description:
Verifies credentials, enforces email verification + account lockout, then
issues a rotated Sanctum token (admins expire in 1h, users in 24h). Returns
422 on bad credentials, 403 when the email is unverified, and 429 with a
`retry_after` when the account is locked.
post.summary: Log in and issue an API token

message.const: Your email address is not verified.
Account temporarily locked due to too many failed attempts.

post.description:
Revokes the caller's current token and issues a fresh one with the same
device name and a renewed expiry.

ExceptionSource.description: Provenance of a date exception. A `Manual` row is a user-created override and is never touched by the holiday sync; a `Holiday` row is system-materialised from the country provider and is purged/rebuilt on a country change or the yearly sync. This is the single source of truth for the `source` column.
ExceptionSource.title: ExceptionSource
